avoid_supplements.name: Warfarin/Anticoagulants (drug interaction)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Icosapent ethyl increases bleeding risk when combined with anticoagulants; additive antiplatelet effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or obtain baseline PT/INR; monitor INR closely if concurrent use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both have antiplatelet properties; synergistic bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E to <400 IU daily or discontinue; counsel on bleeding precautions

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (concentrated extracts)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates antiplatelet effects; increased bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concentrated garlic supplements; counsel patient to discontinue prior to procedures

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; potential additive bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding/bruising; consider discontinuation if signs develop

caution_supplements.name: Fish oil supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Redundant therapy; both are omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use to prevent excessive dosing; icosapent ethyl is prescription-strength alternative

caution_supplements.name: Aspirin (low-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effects; acceptable together in cardiac patients but requires monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Use only if cardioprotection indicated; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (when taking non-food formulations)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May increase GI side effects (nausea, dyspepsia); fat enhances absorption variability
avoid_foods.action: Take with low-fat meals or moderate fat intake; consistent meal timing improves tolerability

caution_foods.name: High omega-6 polyunsaturated fats (vegetable oils in excess)
caution_foods.mechanism: May counteract triglyceride-lowering effects; imbalances omega-3/omega-6 ratio
caution_foods.action: Encourage balanced fat intake; monitor triglyceride response at follow-up visits

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate hypertriglyceridemia and increase bleeding risk
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate alcohol consumption; monitor triglyceride levels if chronic use

monitoring_notes: Monitor lipid panel at 4-8 weeks to assess triglyceride response; assess bleeding risk baseline and periodically, especially if patient requires anticoagulants. Counsel on consistent meal timing and GI tolerance; educate on signs of bleeding and when to seek emergency care.
